whoTheyAre.summary: The live PeopleGroups record identifies Kham Tibetans in China and ties the record to Tibetan, Khams (khg). Glottolog independently identifies Khams Tibetan, while historical scholarship describes Kham as a region with varied local polities and overlapping religious and political institutions rather than one timeless uniform political unit.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG007224 reports PEID 7224, display name Kham Tibetans, country China and primary language Tibetan, Khams (khg).
Glottolog identifies Khams Tibetan with glottocode kham1282 and ISO 639-3 code khg and lists China among its countries.

Historical research describes Kham as a region containing multiple local polities and institutions in which Tibetan religious authorities, local leaders and Qing or later Chinese state authorities interacted in changing ways over time.
claims.interpretationNote: This is bounded historical context. It is not used to infer present political allegiance, territorial preference or a uniform historical experience for every person represented by PG007224.
